notes: TASK-89B0270A stage M1. Generalizes the LearnRepo health pilot to org-wide components by adding an additive 'component' column (default 'LearnRepo') to the existing learnrepo_tasks/schedules/contracts tables and wrapping the existing deterministic checks in aion_core/health.py. No second state store, queue, scheduler, approval system or secret store; escalations flow through the existing deduplicated evidence path into tasks/errors/governor. Feature flag ORGHEALTH_ENABLED (meta table, default off); rollback is 'aion orghealth off' which disables only the LucyOS org schedules. Routine path is deterministic with zero model/API calls; optional components (openclaw gateway, ollama) degrade instead of escalating. Stage M2 (enabling on the canonical brain) is gated on owner review of this branch.
